products.name: HG - Aluminum Grinder - Black 2.5 Inch
products.description: Elevate your grinding experience with the HG Aluminum Grinder in sleek black, a durable 2.5-inch essential for any cannabis enthusiast. This precision-engineered merch piece features aircraft-grade aluminum construction that ensures consistent, fluffy grinds every time. The compact size makes it perfect for on-the-go use while still offering ample capacity for your favorite flower. Sharp, diamond-shaped teeth effortlessly break down dense buds while preserving trichomes and terpenes. The smooth-turning design and secure magnetic lid provide mess-free grinding and storage. Whether you're preparing flower for rolling, vaping, or packing a bowl, this reliable grinder delivers professional results. Its scratch-resistant black finish maintains its premium look session after session, making it both a functional tool and a stylish addition to your collection. An indispensable accessory for anyone serious about their cannabis preparation.
